City plans for growth to accommodate a population of 500,000.

description: Approves multi-sports school at 119 105th Street East.
Allows up to 30 students and 5 staff.
Operates evenings on weekdays, daytime on weekends.

chips.text: Approved
Public notice distributed to nearby residents; no feedback received.

description: Rezones 1224 College Drive to Corridor Station Mixed Use 1.
Allows 3-6 story mixed-use development near transit.
Consolidates with 1226 and 1236 College Drive.

chips.text: Approved
Applicant clarified they did not own the property during previous opt-in.
No public comments or concerns were received on the application.

description: Keeps 133 108th Street West as low-density residential.

chips.text: Approved
Commission discussed evaluating application on full RM3 potential, not specific proposed design.
224 property owners within 150 meters were notified of the proposal.
Applicant stated staff recommended RM3, but current administration suggested rezoning by agreement.
Public expressed concern that approval of the application would create a precedent.
Why was applicant advised to pursue RM3 instead of rezoning by agreement?
Six public responses raised concerns about traffic, parking, and increased density.
Two commissioners opposed denying the rezoning application.

segments.title: Administration Presents Rezoning Proposal
description: Proposal for 133 108th Street West was submitted.
Re-designate from low-density to medium-density residential.
Rezoning from R2 to RM3 for multi-unit dwellings.
Proposal does not align with neighborhood in-fill policies.

chips.text: Six public responses raised concerns about traffic, parking, and density.
Administration recommends denying the application due to policy misalignment.

segments.title: Committee Questions Administration on Rezoning
description: Committee questioned policy alignment and existing RM3 sites.
Administration clarified OCP takes precedence over local area plans.
Reasons for not supporting RM3 zoning were reiterated.
Previous RM3 rezonings in the area were discussed.

chips.text: Administration stated the Official Community Plan is the primary guiding document.

segments.title: Applicant Presents Case for Rezoning
description: Applicant proposes a six-plex townhouse, not a large building.
Current R2 zoning allows a four-plex, seeking a six-plex.
Building would be similar height to neighbors, lower than some.
Site is transit accessible with three bus stops nearby.

segments.title: Discussion on Alternative Zoning Tools and Project Details
description: Committee questioned if RM3 was the only way to build a six-plex.
Administration suggested zoning by agreement as an alternative tool.
Applicant stated administration initially recommended RM3 for the proposal.
Local area plan encourages townhouses up to six units per complex.

chips.text: Applicant and administration had differing views on recommended zoning tools.
Why was RM3 recommended over a zoning by agreement for this specific design?

segments.title: Committee Votes to Deny Rezoning Application
description: Motion made to deny the proposed OCP amendment and rezoning.
Committee voted to deny the application as recommended by administration.
The item will proceed to a public hearing next month for city council.

chips.text: Application for OCP amendment and rezoning was denied by the committee.
Motion carried with 7 members in favor of denial and 3 opposed.
Two committee members explicitly stated their opposition to the denial motion.

description: Updates city sign rules for digital and construction signs.
Sets new brightness limits for digital signs.
Clarifies sign placement and reduces appeals.
Standardizes sign application fees.

chips.text: Approved
Administration noted common complaints relate to digital sign lighting and separation distances.
Applicants for signs will find regulations easier to understand.
Specific data on bylaw complaints and infractions is tracked but not detailed.
Digital signs near natural areas must be de-energized at night.

description: Council approved two daycare centers with specific conditions.
Approved multiple OCP and rezoning amendments for various sites.
Approved Aspen Ridge neighborhood plan and rezoning changes.

chips.text: Received as information
Daycare centers at 21 Young and 1605 Commody Napp Me South.
